search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused research was exhausted. The unresolved atom is the NVIDIA- and Quantum-X-specific relationship; available company-attributed disclosure names only an unnamed GPU AI platform and provides no quantity or revenue denominator.
The January reports are secondary reporting and do not establish the named customer relationship, production status, shipment volume, or revenue.
The later earnings-call statement supports generic GPU-platform adoption only; it neither confirms nor rules out NVIDIA.
The original claim's publication/as-of date is missing, so the relative timing of “近期” cannot be independently assessed.
